title: Tencent Shifts AI Strategy to Enterprise as WorkBuddy Agent Reaches 32M Users
summary:
Tencent is redirecting its artificial intelligence resources away from general-purpose consumer chatbots in favor of tools designed for the corporate sector. This strategic pivot centers on WorkBuddy, an enterprise AI agent that currently reaches 32M monthly users and is utilized by half of China's top 500 companies, more than its rivals' offerings combined.

The shift follows criticism from founder Pony Ma, who characterized the company's AI progress as a "leaky ship" earlier this year. Under Cloud CEO Dowson Tong, the company is now prioritizing business clients to compete with ByteDance, Alibaba, and DeepSeek. To support this expansion, Tencent will release its full Hy4 model and a lower-cost Hy4 Flash version soon to improve reasoning and visual understanding capabilities.
